correctness.rationale: Every never-chosen color has unit weight, giving exact transition P(new parent at t | history)=(t-I_{t-1})/S_{t-1}. The full-state rational enumeration verifies the reduced transition and exact moments (856 assertions). The divergent regimes have a bounded-difference martingale strong law and triangular martingale CLT with conditional quadratic variation asymptotic to the deterministic hazard. In the summable regime first/second Bonferroni bounds show the exact last-activation tail; an infinite survival product gives the star probability. Limits are proved analytically, not inferred from finite data.

originality.rationale: The model is the exact deterministic-color-immigration urn of Singh et al. Their full text contains a one-color marginal theorem and simulations, not the aggregate three-regime parent-activation law, its Gaussian count limit, the eternal-star probability or the last-activation tail. Earlier two-color reinforcement and degree-superlinear attachment results do not imply these statements under their hypotheses; 2025 triggered-novelty models have a different color-creation rule. Record searches and the accessible ledger yielded no equivalent result. An abstract urn-occupancy equivalence remains possible and historical priority is not independently certified.
residual_risks: A different name for dynamically immigrating Pólya colors or a general occupancy martingale may contain an implication-equivalent CLT or last-discovery theorem not uncovered by these searches.
The original source supplies individual-color marginal laws that already imply finite-time expectations by summation, so expectation alone is not asserted as new.
Independence of external proof validation and exhaustive historical-priority certification has not been established.

value.rationale: The number of distinct parents is a structural graph diversity statistic not determined in distribution by any single vertex degree. This theorem gives its sharp polynomial/logarithmic/finite trichotomy, Gaussian count fluctuations, and a quantitative power-law last-activation tail with a moment cutoff. It identifies a meaningful condensation boundary in the first explicit expanding-color reinforcement model.
